recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; do not reapply FHIR-41372 unless a new work-group decision reopens the EventDefinition/SubscriptionTopic boundary.
issue_request: FHIR-41372 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 and requested deprecating EventDefinition in favor of SubscriptionTopic while leaving a pointer to SubscriptionTopic as the preferred event-definition representation.
initial_application: Commit 08d67eccc304ab6749d195a6837b0e848de3d299 from PR HL7/fhir#3864 changed EventDefinition standards-status to deprecated/FMM 0 and added deprecated-in-favor-of-SubscriptionTopic prose.
additional_context: FHIR-41372 continued the deprecation direction from FHIR-21232, but FHIR-53316 was later Applied/Persuasive for R6 and undeprecated EventDefinition because SubscriptionTopic does not cover all EventDefinition use cases. The combined branch already contains a FHIR-53316 no-change audit commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source correctly reflects the later FHIR-53316 decision with EventDefinition normative/FMM 6 and relationship guidance instead of the older deprecation note.
